example.description: Construct the declared 101x101 diagnostic grid with NumPy.
example.code:
from scirel.kinetic.dispersion.rational import jpole_grid_coordinates
r = jpole_grid_coordinates()
assert r['state']['z'].shape == (101, 101)
example.expected: PASS: .venv/bin/python constructs the grid directly on macOS.
